Our story

From one reveal to a reading community.

The Wildkhard Reading Club began in February 2022 with a simple rule: read African books, and talk about them honestly. Our first pick was Damilare Kuku's Nearly All the Men in Lagos Are Mad.

Every month a new book is revealed at the start of the month. Members read at their own pace, share thoughts by text through the weeks, and join a review call on the last Sunday. We have moved through novels, short stories, poetry, plays, essays and testimony, from classics like Nervous Conditions and A Grain of Wheat to new releases, and the work of our own members.

Our members come from different tribes, backgrounds and orientations. The one thing we ask of everyone is respect for each other's opinions and views. The club is a place to disagree well and to support each other.

Where our members read from
